description: export_rows writes broken CSV for values with commas; to_csv_line (never named) does no quoting.

issue.title: Exported CSV has extra columns when a value contains a comma
issue.body: Calling `export_rows(rows, path)` from tools/export.py with a row like `["Smith, Jo", 3]` produces a line with three fields instead of two, so spreadsheets misalign the columns.
